fields.description: Either the HIKVision gateway's recordList CSV export (sName, sJobNo, sCard, Date, Time, IN/OUT, ReadID, EventMainCode, EventSubCode, AttendanceStatus, WearMask, SerialNo, ClockStation) or a legacy tab-separated .DAT export - the format is detected automatically from the file's own content (see Detected Format below). Locked once this import is submitted.
fields.label: Clocking Export File

fields.description: Checkins always use the employee's own Branch (from their Employee record). This is only a fallback for employees who have no Branch set at all - after this, IS Attendance Settings' Clocking Machines mapping is tried as a last resort per checkin's own device. Leave blank to skip straight to that device mapping (or require every employee to have their own Branch, if no device mapping covers them either).
fields.label: Fallback Branch

fields.description: Not Parsed: no file attached yet. Missing Information: file parsed, and either nothing or only some of it resolves. Pending Import: everything resolves, ready for Start Import. Importing: the background job is running. Partially Imported: the background job finished, but some rows were still unresolved - the resolvable ones already became real Employee Checkins, Start Import again once the rest are mapped. Completed: fully resolved and submitted. Error: the background job failed after being queued - see Import Log.
fields.label: Status
fields.options:
Not Parsed
Missing Information
Pending Import
Importing
Partially Imported
Completed
Error

fields.description: Which known shape the attached file was recognised as - see is_attendance.controllers.clocking_parsers.sniff_format(). Blank until the file is parsed.
fields.label: Detected Format

fields.description: How many rows in the file can produce a Checkin right now (employee resolves and a Branch is available). Start Import only ever refuses when this is zero - otherwise it imports whatever's ready and leaves the rest in Issues below for a later pass.
fields.label: Rows Ready Now

fields.description: Employees with at least one checkin in this file that can't get a Branch at all - no Branch on their own Employee record, no Fallback Branch set above, and no Branch mapped for that checkin's own device in IS Attendance Settings' Clocking Machines table either. Set a Branch on these Employees, set a Fallback Branch, or map their device(s) in Settings, to clear this.
fields.label: Employees Without a Branch

fields.description: Every employee code in the file that couldn't be matched to an Employee. Assign an Employee to each row and save - this both clears the issue and permanently records the mapping on that Employee, so future imports resolve it automatically. Submitting is blocked while any issue remains unresolved.
fields.label: Issues
